plant.pendulum_mass_kg.rationale: QNET RIP reference parameter Mp = 0.04 kg.

plant.arm_length_m.rationale: QNET RIP reference parameter Lr = 0.085 m.

plant.pendulum_com_length_m.rationale: QNET RIP reference parameter Lp = 0.129 m.

plant.arm_inertia_kg_m2.rationale: QNET RIP reference equivalent arm inertia Jeq = 5.7e-6 kg*m^2.

plant.pendulum_inertia_kg_m2.rationale: QNET RIP reference pendulum inertia Jp = 1.0e-4 kg*m^2.

plant.gravity_m_s2.rationale: Standard gravitational acceleration value used by the reference model.

plant.arm_viscous_damping_nm_per_rad_s.rationale: Derived from the reference motor constants Kt = Ke = 0.042 and Rm = 8.4 as Kt*Ke/Rm.

plant.pendulum_viscous_damping_nm_per_ra.rationale: Zero damping is an explicit nominal model assumption.

measurement_model.pendulum_upright_adc.rationale: Reference upright count used by the current implementation; not a specimen calibration measurement.

measurement_model.pendulum_radians_per_c.rationale: The vendor path confirms ADC-based angle acquisition; the current 2*pi/4096 angular scale remains a nominal mapping assumption.

measurement_model.pendulum_direction.rationale: Positive pendulum-angle sign convention used by the project.

measurement_model.arm_encoder_counts_per.rationale: Vendor manual specifies 13-line Hall encoder, 1:20 reduction, 260 pulses per output revolution and 1040 counts after x4 quadrature.

measurement_model.arm_encoder_direction.rationale: Positive arm-angle sign convention used by the project; physical sign still requires specimen observation.

virtual_sensor.pendulum_upright_adc.rationale: Virtual sensor intentionally mirrors the production reference offset.

virtual_sensor.pendulum_radians_per_coun.rationale: Virtual sensor nominally mirrors the production angular scale.

virtual_sensor.pendulum_direction.rationale: Virtual sensor uses the same nominal sign convention as the production measurement model.

virtual_sensor.pendulum_adc_modulus.rationale: Virtual device-like ADC evidence uses the STM32F1 12-bit/4096-count nominal range.

virtual_sensor.arm_encoder_counts_per_re.rationale: Virtual encoder mirrors the vendor-documented 1040-count output-shaft quadrature convention.

virtual_sensor.arm_encoder_direction.rationale: Virtual encoder mirrors the production sign convention.

production_actuator_model.torque_per_eff.rationale: Reference static torque span derived from Kt/Rm and the nominal +/-10 V control range.

production_actuator_model.command_deadzo.rationale: Zero normalized-command deadzone is an explicit production-model assumption.

firmware_actuator_mapping.positive_comma.rationale: The board schematic establishes the TB6612 channel wiring; the positive-command mapping remains a project sign convention.

virtual_physical_actuator.torque_per_dut.rationale: Nominal virtual physical truth intentionally starts from the same static torque span while remaining independently configurable.

virtual_physical_actuator.positive_drive.rationale: Virtual physical actuator sign convention for the nominal SITL fixture.
